mainEntity.name: Do I need a building permit for a custom fireplace surround installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Whether a building permit is required for a custom fireplace surround installation depends on the scope of work and local building codes in Alameda, Albany, Berkeley, Dublin, or Emeryville. If the project involves structural modifications, changes to the chimney, or altering gas lines, a permit is typically necessary. Simple decorative changes that don't affect structural integrity or ventilation might not require one. We can assist in determining permit requirements and navigating the application process for your specific project.
